reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience! Almost everything in this app requires payment. You can’t even have a normal conversation with someone without paying. Even if you match with someone, you still have to pay just to send messages and communicate. The whole purpose of a matchmaking app is to help people connect, not force them to pay for every basic feature. Honestly, this app feels like a money-making machine rather than a genuine platform for meeting people. I definitely do not recommend it.
